steps.name: 01 Welcome
steps.goal: Tap Get started on the welcome screen
steps.done: A sign-in sheet titled Get started. with Continue with email

steps.name: Sign in
steps.done: The email entry screen with an empty you@example.com field

steps.name: Email
steps.goal: Enter the email into the email field
steps.done: The email address is in the field

steps.name: Send code
steps.goal: Tap the Send sign-in code button
steps.done: A six-digit code entry screen, with Use a different email

steps.name: Code
steps.goal: Type the sign-in code into the focused code field

steps.name: Tracking prompt
steps.goal: Wait for the iOS tracking permission alert after sign-in. Do not tap anything.
steps.done: A system alert asks to allow omg to track activity, with Ask App Not to Track and Allow buttons

steps.name: Deny tracking
steps.goal: Tap Ask App Not to Track
steps.done: The tracking alert is gone. The app is usable and shows the new account's first question, What to build?
